AUTHOR: Connolly
TITLE: Estimating enhanced fish production on restored shellfish reefs using automated data collection from underwater videos
REGION: Port Phillip Bay (Victoria) and Gulf St Vincent (South Australia), Australia
SPECIES: Temperate nekton incl. Chrysophrys auratus, Meuschenia scaber, Sepioteuthis australis, Trachinops caudimaculatus, Arripis spp. (25 species Victoria model; 12 species South Australia model)
DATA: Own 169 unbaited stereo-RUV deployments (GoPro Hero 9), 3 survey periods 2022-2023; 11,443 annotated frames
V_EV: Sec. 2.2: 'Water clarity measured as the distance fish can be seen from each camera deployment ... Dromana 1.6 and 1.7 m, Maragaret 1.7 and 2.2 m, Glenelg 1.1 and 1.1 m'
D2: Victoria 20,201/5,996/5,202 annotations; South Australia 5,821/1,835/994 (train/eval/test); unit not stated
D_EV: Sec. 2.3: 'Annotations from each state were further split into training, evaluation and testing data sets.' (no split unit stated)
R_EV: Sec. 2.3: 'Screening, annotation and detection model training procedures were repeated after each sampling event to avoid domain shift.' (no external test)
C_EV: Sec. 2.3: 'we selected an optimal inference confidence threshold for each species that balanced Precision and Recall' (threshold values not given in main text)
E_EV: Sec. 2.3: 'Filtered fish detections per species and video were averaged to produce a Mean Count.'; juvenile densities and biomass enhancement (Table 3) with no comparison to manual/independent counts
ARCH: YOLOv5 (FishID software), state-specific models; stereo sizing, KDE juvenile proportion, effective-area density, growth/mortality biomass model
NOTE: Ecology-focused paper. Split unit (frames/videos) not stated -> D NR. Per-species optimal thresholds balancing P/R are described (justified) but values are only possibly in Table S2 (supplement not available); if Table S2 lists thresholds, C1 = Y and C_ALL = P. Rare-species detections 'manually curated and checked' without FP count (not coded as C5). Sizing appears to be done from stereo video (possibly manual/semi-automated in software); stereo calibrated against known-size objects, not fish. Mean Count computed per deployment; densities and biomass reported but never compared with manual counts or independent census. PLAT coded BRUV although rigs are unbaited RUVs. ENV: restored shellfish reefs vs unstructured soft sediment in temperate bays (coded 온대 암반/켈프; alternative 혼합). Dryad data shared (content may be abundance data rather than imagery).
